_A_RATE_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The ARate component shows a rating with icons and lets the user choose a value from 1 to max. It is a form element: it has a label, help text, errors, read-only mode and works in AForm. The model is a number, 0 means «not rated».
_A_RATE_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_:
Accessibility: the component is one focusable element with role="slider". Its name is the label, aria-valuetext contains the value and the text of the value (for example «3 of 5, Okay»). The icons are hidden from screen readers. In read-only mode the icons are an image (role="img") with the same text.

  • Arrow right/up: higher value, Arrow left/down: lower value (with allow-half in steps of 0.5, in right-to-left languages the arrows are swapped).
  • Home / End: lowest / highest value.
  • Digit keys: set the value directly.
  • Delete / Backspace: remove the rating (only with clearable).
_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: How satisfied are you with our service?
_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_HELP_TEXT_: Click the same icon again to remove the rating
_A_RATE_GROUP_MAX_DESCRIPTION_: max sets the number of icons and the highest value (default 5).
_A_RATE_GROUP_ALLOW_HALF_DESCRIPTION_: With allow-half the left half of an icon selects a half value. The keyboard changes the value in steps of 0.5.
_A_RATE_GROUP_COLORS_DESCRIPTION_: The value is in one of three levels: up to low-threshold (default 2), from high-threshold (default 4) and between. colors is a color, an array with three colors (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys. Without colors the CSS variables --a_rate_fill_color_low, _medium and _high are used.
_A_RATE_GROUP_ICONS_DESCRIPTION_: icons is the filled icon: an icon, an array with three icons (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys, like colors. void-icon is the empty icon. Icons are names of registered icons or SVG strings.
_A_RATE_GROUP_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: show-text shows the text of the value after the icons. texts is an array with a text (or a translation key) for every value, by default 5 texts. The text of a half value is the text of the next whole value. The text is also part of aria-valuetext.
_A_RATE_GROUP_SCORE_DESCRIPTION_: show-score shows the value after the icons. score-template is a text or a translation key with {{value}} and {{max}}.
_A_RATE_GROUP_CLEARABLE_DESCRIPTION_: With clearable a click on the current value or Delete / Backspace removes the rating. The model then gets model-undefined (default 0).
_A_RATE_GROUP_DISABLED_DESCRIPTION_: disabled shows the icons, but the value cannot be changed and the component is not focusable. readonly shows the rating as an image, also with decimal values like 3.7.
_A_RATE_GROUP_HELP_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: help-text and label-description are connected to the component with aria-describedby.
_A_RATE_GROUP_ERRORS_DESCRIPTION_: errors shows the error text, colors the empty icons and sets aria-invalid.
_A_RATE_GROUP_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm and AGroup the component is used with type: "rate".
_A_RATE_GROUP_CSS_DESCRIPTION_: Colors and sizes are CSS variables (table at the end of the page). They can be set for the whole project or for one component, for example with style or a class.
_A_RATE_PROPS_CLEARABLE_DESCRIPTION_: Allows removing the rating: click on the current value, Delete or Backspace.
_A_RATE_PROPS_COLORS_DESCRIPTION_: Color of the filled icons: a color, an array with three colors (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys.
_A_RATE_PROPS_HIGH_THRESHOLD_DESCRIPTION: From this value the level is high.
_A_RATE_PROPS_ICONS_DESCRIPTION_: Filled icon: an icon, an array with three icons (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys.
_A_RATE_PROPS_LOW_THRESHOLD_DESCRIPTION_: Up to this value the level is low.
_A_RATE_PROPS_MAX_DESCRIPTION_: Number of icons and highest value.
_A_RATE_PROPS_SCORE_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION: Text or translation key of the score with {{value}} and {{max}}.
_A_RATE_PROPS_SHOW_SCORE_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the value after the icons.
_A_RATE_PROPS_SHOW_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the text of the value after the icons.
_A_RATE_PROPS_SIZE_DESCRIPTION_: Size of the icons: small or large.
_A_RATE_PROPS_TEXTS_DESCRIPTION_: Texts or translation keys for the values 1 to max.
_A_RATE_PROPS_TYPE_DESCRIPTION_: Type of the form element. Used by AForm to choose the component.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_HOVERED_COLOR_D: Deprecated, use the CSS variable --a_rate_hover_fill_color. Will be removed in 4.0.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_TEXT_DESCRIPTIO: Deprecated, use show-text and texts or label. Will be removed in 4.0.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_RATING_DESCRIPT: Deprecated, use max. Will be removed in 4.0.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_HALF_ICON_DESCR: Deprecated, use allow-half. Will be removed in 4.0.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_ICON_DESCRIPTIO: Deprecated, use void-icon. Will be removed in 4.0.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_ICON_FILL_DESCR: Deprecated, use icons. Will be removed in 4.0.
_A_RATE_PROPS_DEPRECATED_COLOR_DESCRIPTI: Deprecated, use colors. Will be removed in 4.0.
